horoscopes.horoscope: You may pick up the hammer and chisel today. No, you’re not taking up sculpture; you’re finally giving in to your spouse’s demands to take some home improvement measures. It’s in your interest to be speedy and focused, as you are the guilty party, says Ganesha. Your lover will appreciate your devotion to your family and will be more than happy to be with you. You will do anything for your sweetheart. Ganesha feels that cooperation and togetherness are the keys to strengthening relationship. Today, despite good health you may not probably be in a good mood to work. You should exercise at home if you can’t go to gym. Ganesha also suggests you to go for a long and relaxing walk to ‘feel’ better. Today you are likely to incur expenses on the health of family members. Though the chances of very high range expenses are slim, you are likely to spend money on petty requirements. You are fast but calm. Your warm and sympathetic attitude will lure others to you. Ganesha foresees that you will give a helping hand to colleagues at the workplace. You may even go to the extent of doing their work for them.

You will find comfort, perched on a branch in the family tree, today. Your maturity will help you deal with emotional issues with ease. Energy and exuberance will be an investment you make today, the results of which you will reap in the days to come, hopes Ganesha. You may not deliberately bring your spice head to the bedroom. Instead, you will feel that you need to go a bit slow but steady. You will eventually express your feelings to your partner and you will let him/her know your deepest emotions, feels Ganesha. There are higher chances of you getting closer to people you like as your communication will be very smooth with them today. All these things can impact your health positively. This is not a good day for taking heavy workload, feels Ganesha. Ganesha advises that it is better to think twice before spending money. You should not take decisions impulsively and should see to it that money is spent in right direction at the right time. Bravo! You will win your challenge today. You will get devoted to work throughout the day. Your focus and sincerity will accomplish many difficult tasks and eventually fetch appreciation from colleagues and boss. As a result, you may receive some important gains, feels Ganesha.

Your desire for a clean house will reach the level of obsession, predicts Ganesha. You may plan to wash your car, clean your yard and arrange your wardrobe. And you don’t trust the housemaid with any of the chores, because no one can clean the house better than you. Personal hygiene will also get your full attention, feels Ganesha. Get prepared to laugh and love, says Ganesha. You may like to indulge in exchanging sweet things with your love mate. You are in a joyful mood to attract his/her attention. Some interesting topics will surely be engaging throughout the night, feels Ganesha. On your desk, the pile of files may be high today. But, you shall be in a mood to relax and take things lightly. After completing important tasks, Ganesha advises you to enjoy the evening with family or friends. You should remember that fast moving planets give temporal joys and temporary results. Whatever you are likely to gain today may not give you very long term financial pleasure or stability. Avoid handling a project involving technical issues today, because your current astral configuration may prevent you from making a headway. You don’t need to take the hard-hitting decisions on important projects. Solve the simple tasks instead, suggests Ganesha.

Today is a crucial and fascinating day for you, predicts Ganesha. You will learn and gain from your bosses and elders. Peers and siblings may extend their full support to you. Your chances of winning legal battles are remote, so an out-of-court settlement may be your best bet. Luck is in your favour tonight. You can indulge in different activities you have planned for your sweetheart. The good thing is that you understand your lover really well. The affection your lover will shower on you will fill your heart with unparalleled happiness. On this dull day, your head and heart are going to swing in two different directions. Hence, Ganesha advises you to overcome your feelings, and think practically. Avoid reacting to adverse circumstances – just take it easy and move ahead. Suppose if someone approaches you with a very good plan of business or shows you plan to double your money in shorter time – do not trust the person or that scheme blindly. Good thing is that you take your profession seriously. It’s the best day of the month to solve technical issues. Your presentation skills will be at their best today. Appreciation from the boss is warranted. Do not forget to give credits to your teammates and colleagues, reminds Ganesha.

This day brings good tidings for jobs and businesses. Those in business can look forward to a highly profitable day. Long-term business deals may be in the offing as well. If you happen to be in the services, rest assured, you may look forward to extra perks, pay hike and promotions. Just make sure that you hone your skills to reach where you want to be, advises Ganesha. The idea of spending a quiet and private evening with your darling will thrill you. You want to enjoy this evening in the arms of your lover. You may feel that your life turns out to be the best when your soulmate makes you happy and successful, says Ganesha. Ganesha says that you are likely to feel very anxious today for some reason or another. Also check your anger and avoid debating over trivial matters. Simply concentrate on your work and things will get sorted as the day ends. Material investments will give you temporal joy only. Instead, it will be good to invest money on spiritual development, Yoga classes or something that helps you find more peace. This is not the right day to launch a bold new venture, warns Ganesha. Take it up some other day, advises Ganesha. Feeling insecure will only bring down your productivity. Work on the simple tasks that can fetch the maximum results, suggests Ganesha.

Today finds you ambitious and meticulous. Actions will not speak – they’ll roar! Your planning and scruples will set the pace at work. Expect pats on the back from your bosses and a round of cheers from your peers. Your life partner must also be your best friend as he or she is ready to sacrifice. You will treat your loved one with utmost care, love, and sincerity. This will bring your relationship to a higher level of understanding, says Ganesha. With your energy levels rising today, Ganesha advises you to utilise your time and energy for doing physically and mentally challenging tasks. After working hard throughout the day, you should enjoy the evening with your near and dear ones. If your pocket permits it, you will buy it – or else, you will wait for better time. Your logical and analytical mind will not be provoked to spend money without any base. You will be friendly with everyone today. The amazing rapport you share with your colleagues will make work enjoyable, faster, and productive. You will feel confident in what you are doing. You may suggest some ideas in order to improve certain areas in the workplace, feels Ganesha.

Of late, you have been very concerned about the health of one of your close friends. Take this day to lay your fears to rest by spending time with that friend. Work can wait, as today you must prove to yourself, if not to others, that ‘a friend in need is a friend indeed’. Ganesha wishes you the very best. Everything is not OK on the personal front, foresees Ganesha. An emotional conflict is on the cards today. Taking a hard line will only hurt your partner. After all, it’s the give-and-take in your relationship which will add harmony to your love life, says Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that today you shall be overflowing with zeal and vigour. So, just divert your energy in the right direction, and properly expend your time by doing productive activities. Also devise plans related to all areas of your life. You should try to maintain very good terms with higher-ups in other organizations. People in authority can really be very helpful in finding you some good financial opportunities. You may earn some important points for your performance today if you stimulate your creative instinct, suggests Ganesha. Art, beauty, and style will make up your mood today. Your seniors may praise for your achievement at the workplace, feels Ganesha.

Your mind shall take over the proceedings today. And it shall, in all likeliness, draw you to the work bench and keep your nose to the grindstone. But your heart will flutter like a butterfly, and if you manage to strike the right balance, you may win over your special one and your boss too, says Ganesha. You are in a rosy mood to get turned on by your partner. You want to see something special in your sweetheart, feels Ganesha. You will be smitten by your loved one today. There’s certainly a romantic episode waiting to play itself out. Ganesha says that today, you should simply execute all your tasks. Do not waste your time and energy to prepare a strategy. This is advisable, because your plans may be impractical, and hence you may not get the desired results. You will exactly know how much you want and how much you can compromise. Such an approach will help turn the game on your side. In other words, the day seems good for negotiations. You will feel special today. You are focused, determined, confident and productive. Thanks to your stars’ awesome placement. Ganesha thinks the day is great for everything you do in the office. If you wrap up routine work in a jiffy, you will have time to focus on other things.

Chances of you hitting a roadblock today are high. But remember the saying, ‘When the going gets tough, the tough get going. ’ So don’t succumb to pressure, advises Ganesha, but rise up to the occasion and show who’s the boss. You need to be extremely careful in handling emotional matters, says Ganesha. Chances are that you may hurt your lover unconsciously and then immediately start apologising for the misconduct. The good news is that your emotional soul is awakening and the lover in you is ready to compromise. Regarding your health, this day looks to be less favourable. You may get up in the morning feeling very lethargic. With your mood also swinging downwards, you shall desire to take a day’s off and just relax at home, says Ganesha. Today you are not going to be good with finances. You will be spending money without thinking deeply about gains or returns. It is better to keep the purse-strings tight, rather than spending money blindly. Today, you want to refuel your energy to finish all the pending tasks. However, make sure that it doesn’t take a toll on your health. Planning, organising or prioritising tasks carefully will definitely make your work faster and release your tensions, suggests Ganesha.

Today, you will remain unruffled by the commotion around you, says Ganesha. However, the emotions locked up inside you will probably cloud your power of reasoning and may leave you feeling a little lost. But this will only be a passing phase, and you will come out of the bewilderment in no time. You will promptly get back to pursuing your goals and your reputation with seniors will play a crucial role in bagging you tangible rewards. Emotional issues in your personal life will pull you down, foresees Ganesha. Disagreement is on the cards. Either one of you may behave aggressively. Ganesha advises you to do whatever it takes to keep your cool. You need to handle the situation wisely. Ganesha suggests that instead of wasting your precious time and energy after futile tasks, just remain focussed on fruitful activities. This will lead to sense of satisfaction, and also appreciation from your seniors in office and elders at home today. You may start viewing things from other people’s eyes before taking call on financial matters. Ganesha feels that it is better to have your own opinion about everything on this front. Today’s astral alignment will throw up many challenges. If you feel it’s really getting stressful, plan and strategise properly. Managing work is equally important as managing your emotion. A certain change in work style may give you the much-needed break from your boredom.

Today, you will experience the harmonious balance between logic and emotion. You will consequently know how to mix business with pleasure. Money wise, you are content, but trivial issues may bother you today, says Ganesha. Misunderstandings are foreseen due to a certain course of action. Sort out the issues immediately if you want to be happy. You need to adopt different ways to amuse your sweetheart so that both of you will enjoy the thrilling, chilling, and exciting nights forever, suggests Ganesha. On this very hectic day, you will have to simultaneously work on different tasks. This may decrease your energy at a faster rate, and cause fatigue. To rest your tired muscles and overworked mind, take adequate sleep advises Ganesha. The day is in your favour if you are willing to start providing services to some organization. You may be paid well for your services. While quoting a price, ensure that you are able to give competitive price. Your productivity will multiply today, courtesy your swift action formula. This vigour calls for spending extra hours in front of your PC. You will maintain excellence. You will not mind it as you believe that hard work always pays off, feels Ganesha.

An action-packed day awaits you, busy as you will be corresponding with old contacts, telephonic interviews, organising meetings and scheduling tasks, says Ganesha. Do not forget to breathe!. This is the perfect day if you are planning to propose someone, foresees Ganesha. You need to be confident and serious in the world full of imagination and beauty. The romantic evening you will spend with your sweetheart will end your day on a positive note. You are likely to remain very fit and fine on this bright and beautiful day, says Ganesha. In a joyous mood since morning, you will easily handle your tasks on all the fronts. Enjoy the evening with your friends or family. Financially, this is going to be a good day, says Ganesha. You will be able to spend good money on yourself and also on others. You will be lucky and will be receiving desired financial gains. Sharpen your skills today, advises Ganesha. This will improve your performance at work. Your passion for learning will grow more. The perfect combination of creativity and technology will be very effective. Find the best ways to bring the result-driven success.
